Docs may overstate behaviour.

findings.claim: The 'continue' on mixed key kinds changes which members are collected for generated (non-suppressed) types too, and the dedupe guards silently drop duplicate-key members. This alters the member set for normal types, which could change generator output, though only for code that already has an error diagnostic. Acceptance criterion says unset/false behaviour must not change.
